_README: HAND-VERIFIED Steam -> Store address pairs. Applied LAST by
s2_emit_buildmap.py, so they beat the automated matcher.
This file exists because the matcher CAN be wrong. It forces a pair only
when a size is unambiguous on both sides, which is what buys 99.36%
precision -- but a function that genuinely CHANGED SIZE between builds
cannot be matched that way, and call-graph propagation may then hand its
Store twin to some unrelated same-sized function.
Every entry needs evidence written down. An override with no stated basis
is worse than a gap, because a gap faults loudly and a wrong entry does not.
